_comment: A fixed content snapshot and the store codes on the listings it should match.
Synthetic: the Statamic site holds no clinical_locations entries yet, and the live
listings need the Google credentials to read. The shapes follow the WordPress sync's
rules: a location is its slug or parent_child, a provider is person_location with the
location's own slug. The last two existing codes and the last generated one are
deliberate differences, each with the cause the comparison must name.

differences.cause: a slug is cut short against main-campus_orthopaedic-surgery-and-sports-medicine
no listing carries it, so the sync would create one
no content generates it, so the sync never updates that listing
a slug is cut short against main-campus_orthopaedic-surgery
